verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and quickly accessing one-time passwords. Items can be grouped into vaults, as shown by vault-scoped listing and a user's department-based vaults. The browser docs only vaguely say users can 'find what you need', and nothing shows search, folders or icons applied to dozens of OTP codes. Missing for 10: explicit search for OTP items, folder or tag organization documented for OTP codes, service icons, evidence of two-tap access at scale, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
